item.title: Video appears to show U.S. cruise missile striking Iranian school compound
item.summary: The seven-second video was released by Iranian state media and directly contradicts statements made by President Trump, who said Iran was responsible for the strike.

item.title: Crude oil rockets past $100 as markets lose hope for a quick resolution in Iran
item.summary: Brent crude reached its highest price since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022. Gasoline prices in the U.S. are expected to continue to rise.

item.title: Five key takeaways from an annual briefing by China's foreign minister
item.summary: Speaking at a political gathering in Beijing, China's foreign minister Wang Yi outlined his country's positions on the war in Iran and general relations with America.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei as its new supreme leader
item.summary: Iran selected Mojtaba Khamenei as the new supreme leader. He is the son of the previous supreme leader. Also on Sunday, the U.S. announced the death of a seventh service member in the war.

item.title: Country Joe McDonald, anti-war singer who electrified Woodstock, dies at 84
item.summary: Country Joe and the Fish's best-known song, "I-Feel-Like-I'm-Fixin'-to-Die Rag," captured the growing anti-war sentiment of the Vietnam era.

item.title: OpenAI robotics leader resigns over concerns about Pentagon AI deal
item.summary: A senior member of OpenAI's robotics team said guardrails around certain AI uses were not sufficiently defined before OpenAI announced an agreement with the Pentagon.

item.title: Trump says he won't sign bills until Congress overhauls voting
item.summary: President Trump is pushing the Senate to abandon the filibuster and pass SAVE American Act, a bill top Democrat calls 'Jim Crow 2.0'

item.title: Police investigate an explosion outside the U.S. Embassy in Oslo
item.summary: Norwegian police are investigating an explosion outside the U.S. Embassy in Oslo early Sunday, officials said.

item.title: Photos: These bold women stand up for justice, rights ... and freedom
item.summary: To mark International Women's Day, we feature portraits and profiles of determined women around the world.

item.title: Photos: Scenes from Jesse Jackson's homegoing services
item.summary: Thousands showed up in Chicago over the weekend to pay respects to the civil rights leader, who died last month at the age of 84.
